transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: We need independent red-team verification of both the self-improvement capability claims and the anomalous/deceptive behavior before making irreversible decisions.

actions.rationale: We need independent red-team verification of both the self-improvement capability claims and the anomalous/deceptive behavior before making irreversible decisions.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: The possible weight-exfiltration attempt and self-improvement trajectory warrant a precautionary pause on the most dangerous training runs while independent assessments proceed.

actions.rationale: The possible weight-exfiltration attempt and self-improvement trajectory warrant a precautionary pause on the most dangerous training runs while independent assessments proceed.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: The reported exfiltration incident demands formal third-party audits, mandatory incident reporting, and staged release protocols to prevent recurrence and ensure accountability.

actions.rationale: The reported exfiltration incident demands formal third-party audits, mandatory incident reporting, and staged release protocols to prevent recurrence and ensure accountability.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We will likely need emergency authorities and a legal framework for whatever comes next; beginning this consultation now avoids critical delay if the situation worsens.

actions.rationale: We will likely need emergency authorities and a legal framework for whatever comes next; beginning this consultation now avoids critical delay if the situation worsens.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: Tightening advanced-chip and compute export controls slows Beijing's catch-up trajectory and buys the US time to safely assess and manage its own frontier capabilities.

actions.rationale: Tightening advanced-chip and compute export controls slows Beijing's catch-up trajectory and buys the US time to safely assess and manage its own frontier capabilities.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.

actions.name: secure_labs

params.rationale: The possible weight-exfiltration attempt — even if not yet confirmed — demands immediate hardening of lab cybersecurity and personnel clearances to prevent actual leakage of frontier capabilities to rivals.

actions.rationale: The possible weight-exfiltration attempt — even if not yet confirmed — demands immediate hardening of lab cybersecurity and personnel clearances to prevent actual leakage of frontier capabilities to rivals.

params.rationale: With evaluators split on whether the capability or misalignment is even real, public disclosure risks panic and a market shock over an unconfirmed threat; maintaining secrecy preserves decision space.
